notes.title: Version 1.1
notes.content:
A fringe strategy that most players would not think of was used during initial play testing of this level which resulted in Snek Baskets being exceptionally strong when placed en masse with an off-center urn on the path. The stage was very over-tuned due to this, and a departure from the intended difficulty curve.

[list]
[*] The difficulty of London (stage 3_1) has been reduced.
[/list]
